card.name: The end of "mania" in bipolar
card.fires_on: The final piece "ia" of the word "mania" after "man", almost always in "bipolar mania" in trial descriptions of antipsychotic labels. Weakly on "infections" after "Clostridial".

modes.label: Bipolar mania trials
modes.description: The ending "ia" completes "mania" in phrases about bipolar mania studies or indications.

modes.label: Clostridial infections
modes.description: A rare case on "infections" after "Clostridial" in a dosing list.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated word endings in several languages, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires when the word "mania" is being finished, as in "bipolar mania" trials in antipsychotic labels.
